mapper.select: SELECT a.admin_no, a.admin_id, a.admin_password, a.admin_name, a.admin_email, a.admin_nickname, a.admin_image_url, a.admin_created, a.admin_updated, r.role_name FROM tb_admin a LEFT JOIN tb_admin_role ar ON a.admin_no = ar.admin_no LEFT JOIN tb_role r ON ar.role_no = r.role_no WHERE a.admin_id = #{adminId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(user_no) FROM tb_user) AS totalUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(user_no) FROM tb_user WHERE DATE(user_created) = CURRENT_DATE) AS todayUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(feed_no) FROM tb_feed) AS totalFeedCount, (SELECT COUNT(feed_no) FROM tb_feed WHERE DATE(feed_created) = CURRENT_DATE) AS todayFeedCount, (SELECT COUNT(inquiry_no) FROM tb_inquiry WHERE inquiry_status = 'PENDING') AS pendingInquiryCount, (SELECT COUNT(notice_no) FROM tb_notice) AS totalNoticeCount, (SELECT COUNT(notice_no) FROM tb_notice WHERE notice_visible_yn = 'Y') AS visibleNoticeCount
